map.先去掉首尾空白；以 r 或 R 开头时判为原始字符串并去掉该前缀。随后去掉成对的: Leading and trailing whitespace is removed first; a leading r or R marks a raw string and the prefix is stripped. Matching triple double quotes, or matching outer double or single quotes, are then removed. Raw-string mode directly replaces "backslash + any character" with the character itself. Otherwise it scans character by character: on a backslash followed by another character, it escapes by the following character — n to newline, r to carriage return, t to tab, b to backspace, f to form feed, v to vertical tab, a to bell, 0 to the null character, and backslash and single/double quotes to themselves; x takes the following 2 hex digits, u the following 4, and U the following 8, parsed base-16 as a code point to produce a character; when the following character is an octal digit, up to 3 consecutive octal digits are parsed base-8 as a code point; otherwise the following character itself is taken. Characters that are not escape sequences are kept as-is
